info.name: PayFlow — Slice 2 fail-closed HTTP validation
info.description: Local manual validation only. Read README.md first. Business requests MUST return 401/403. Token helpers never belong in shared exports. No Origin header, no cookies, desktop agent.

item.name: 00 — Token setup (send individually; do not run this folder)
Optional — Merchant token via restricted Payment service account

request.description: Merchant audience ONLY. Enter private development secret locally; never sync/export it. No Payment API audience can be requested.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get("payment_service_client_secret")) throw new Error("Set the development client secret privately first");

item.name: Merchant API token — exchange browser PKCE code

request.description: Read README: use a generated authorization URL, log in through Keycloak, then copy the failed-loopback callback URL locally. Do not use Postman default callbacks. Codes are short-lived and single use.

exec: if (!callback.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error("Paste the exact registered local callback URL");
const key = decodeURIComponent(i < 0 ? part : part.slice(0, i));
if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, key)) throw new Error("Duplicate callback parameter");
if (!state || params.state !== state || !params.code || params.error) throw new Error("Missing code or invalid OAuth state");
if (!pm.environment.get("merchant_code_verifier")) throw new Error("Generate the private PKCE session first");

item.name: Payment API token — exchange browser PKCE code

request.description: Read README: use a generated authorization URL, log in through Keycloak, then copy the failed-loopback callback URL locally. Do not use Postman default callbacks. Codes are short-lived and single use.

exec: if (!callback.startsWith(prefix)) throw new Error("Paste the exact registered local callback URL");
const key = decodeURIComponent(i < 0 ? part : part.slice(0, i));
if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(params, key)) throw new Error("Duplicate callback parameter");
if (!state || params.state !== state || !params.code || params.error) throw new Error("Missing code or invalid OAuth state");
if (!pm.environment.get("payment_code_verifier")) throw new Error("Generate the private PKCE session first");

request.description: Expected 200. No Origin header. Do not replace a failed authentication test with an authorization claim.

exec: pm.test("Minimal healthy response", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property("components"); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property("details"); });
